report:
Reassessed the complete scheduling-independence claim and both implementation/test entries. With semantic inputs and configured limits fixed, answer class, output, substitutions, residuals, hints, response numbering, ambiguity versus overflow, and overflow kind must be invariant; discovery, cancellation timing, traces, elapsed work, and memory may vary.

Source evidence: merge_candidate_results sorts and deduplicates completed candidates before selection. Its unconditional Proven/empty-substitution/trivial-residual branch returns the same candidate, and complete empty or singleton reductions are deterministic. The associated final_answer_rules_are_order_independent test visibly compares the entire returned stashed answer against the unconditional answer for three No/Maybe/Yes orderings; it also checks duplicate Maybe remains Maybe and duplicate No remains No. Setup helpers yes, maybe, and no_result are in the captured implementation file. This is meaningful limited evidence for final-answer reduction, not ready-queue scheduling, nonempty substitutions/hints, response numbering, normalization, or resource exhaustion.

The second implementation entry and solver_schedule_independence test in semantic_spec.rs explicitly defer deterministic resource accounting and scheduler perturbation guarantees. Its empty body provides no behavioral evidence. The stated future matrix requires byte-identical stashed results for perturbed ready queues across proof, normalization, residual, ambiguity, and every overflow case. Together with the implementation TODO, this accounts for the remaining invariant fields and ambiguity/overflow taxonomy. Prerequisites are deterministic resource accounting and a controllably perturbed scheduler capable of exercising each limit class and comparing complete canonical responses while permitting nonsemantic timing/work/trace differences. These remain deferred, not implemented. No additional edits are needed to the existing explicit accounting.

Baseline: independently verified exact equality of both current whole-file implementation fragments against both historical implementation_sources and test_sources, and equality of claim, implementation metadata, test bodies, and test metadata after removing the legacy embedded source field. Reassessed the captured prior rationale against current assertions rather than treating the old verdict as approval. All substantive behavior relied upon is in the initial captured files; review policy was additionally captured with review read.

Execution: personally ran review start with the supplied instructions, review read, and exact-comparison scripts; recording completes this review. No behavioral tests or build were run by this reviewer. The coordinator-reported 321 passing sage-meta tests and successful root build are separate baseline execution, not evidence that the deferred scheduling matrix ran.
